title: 窗口关闭驻留托盘与正式产品 README

authorization.source: 2026-11-20 user request: 基于 PR #10，修复关闭窗口后收缩到托盘、仅通过托盘退出，并正式更新 README，加入程序截图、能力、功能和版本；创建专属 PR。
operations: create isolated task worktree from merged PR #10
implement and verify close-to-tray lifecycle and README/screenshots

revisions.request: 版本号递增小 1，即 1.1.1；继续完成剩余内容
revisions.scope: Bump the desktop package and lockfile version to 1.1.1, update the Settings version expectation and README, and capture screenshots from the 1.1.1 renderer.
revisions.acceptance: Package metadata, lockfile and Settings display show 1.1.1; README and screenshots identify/show that application version; all prior tray and PR requirements remain in scope.

revisions.scope: Make update checks visibly responsive while pending, explain when no GitHub update token is configured, and provide a direct action to focus the token field.
revisions.acceptance: The check action immediately announces a pending state and prevents duplicate requests; an unconfigured result explains that the check did not run and offers a button that focuses the token input.

revisions.request: 发布1.1.1版，并在本地桌面生成直接可打开的程序
revisions.scope: After PR #11 merge, build and verify Windows x64 NSIS and single-file portable 1.1.1 executables, copy the verified portable executable to the Desktop without overwriting an existing file, publish GitHub Release v1.1.1 with assets and release notes, and record hashes/evidence.
revisions.acceptance: Release verifier passes; portable executable passes isolated direct-launch health smoke; final Desktop copy SHA-256 matches; GitHub Release v1.1.1 contains the verified installer and portable app; PR merge commit is integrated into the primary master worktree while preserving pre-existing files.
